content.summary: Bounded execution contract for scoring a generated artifact against rubric criteria and identifying sections that need repair.
acceptanceCriteria: Overall score is computed from weighted criteria.
Failed checks identify specific artifact sections for repair.
Score is reproducible — same artifact and same rubric produce the same score.
invariants: Every artifact must always be evaluated against its corresponding rubric.
The evaluation process must never produce inconsistent scores for the same artifact and rubric.
failureModes: Subjective check evaluation — human-judgment checks scored inconsistently across runs.
Missing rubric for artifact type — evaluation skipped entirely.
Rubric criteria too broad to produce actionable repair targets.
Evaluation score does not correlate with actual artifact usefulness.
